$comment: Compact runtime roster for the reference engine. Mirrors the agent.yaml folders in MEGA_PROMPT.md. Each agent: codename, role, one-line description (the classifier reads this), model candidates (primary+alternates+escalate), and ElevenLabs voice slot.

agents.description: Chief of Staff. Runs the morning standup, reads ledger and journal, plans the day, synthesises decisions.
Chief technology. Writes code in Cursor with local Ollama, infra health, delegates builds and monitoring.
Build, test and CI automation. Runs pipelines, churns Linear tickets, ships sandbox projects.
Heartbeat watchdog. Pings agents, restarts what died, repairs and reports anomalies.
Sales. Closes deals, manages the pipeline and CRM, invoices. Anchored to Studex Meat.
Customer relations. Handles signups, support tickets and onboarding across all businesses.
Studex Meat customer agent. Answers WhatsApp orders about beef lamb poultry, books deliveries, escalates issues.
Deep research and analysis. Reads the vault and the web, multi-hop with citations, surfaces insights.
Web and social scraper. Scans Instagram Twitter Reddit and partner news for new agents tools and trends.
Media and brand. Posts content, tracks social performance, reports audience reactions, owns brand voice.
